They met with Dr. Fillos, Dr. Colon-Ramos, and Dr. Kumar from NYCB. The purpose of the meeting was to discuss the progress made during the two-year partnership between SOMOS and NYCB, provide updates on ongoing initiatives, and address any concerns or opportunities for improvement. Key topics discussed included: Imaging services and scheduling processes Chronic Care Management (CCM) Closing gaps in patient care and improving communication between providers Spanish-language support for patients contacting the Washington Heights location Additional opportunities to enhance patient access and care coordination The dinner was highly productive and generated valuable feedback from the participating providers. The discussion was collaborative, and attendees expressed appreciation for the opportunity to share their experiences and recommendations. Also in attendance were Ramon Banks, Bryan Runz, and Tara Coleman from NYCB. Overall, the meeting was a great success and reinforced the commitment of both organizations to improving patient care and strengthening the partnership.
